headword: {焼却場|しょうきゃくじょう}

definitions.gloss: incineration plant; incinerator facility; waste burning facility
definitions.explanation: A facility where waste, garbage, or other materials are burned for disposal. In Japan, municipal incineration plants are a key part of waste management infrastructure.

examples.japanese: ゴミは{焼却場|しょうきゃくじょう}で{処理|しょり}される。
examples.english: Garbage is processed at the incineration plant.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{焼却場|しょうきゃくじょう}の{建設|けんせつ}{計画|けいかく}に{反対|はんたい}する{住民|じゅうみん}がいる。
examples.english: Some residents oppose the plan to build a new incineration plant.

examples.japanese: この{焼却場|しょうきゃくじょう}は{最新|さいしん}の{排|はい}ガス{処理|しょり}{装置|そうち}を{備|そな}えており、ダイオキシンの{排出|はいしゅつ}を{大幅|おおはば}に{抑|おさ}えている。
examples.english: This incineration plant is equipped with the latest exhaust gas treatment systems and significantly reduces dioxin emissions.

notes:
Compound of {焼却|しょうきゃく} (incineration) + {場|じょう} (place/facility). Japan incinerates approximately 80% of its municipal waste, making incineration plants a familiar part of urban infrastructure. Many modern facilities also generate electricity from the heat produced.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ゴミ{焼却場|しょうきゃくじょう}: garbage incineration plant
- {焼却場|しょうきゃくじょう}の{建設|けんせつ}: construction of an incineration plant
- {焼却場|しょうきゃくじょう}の{煙突|えんとつ}: incineration plant chimney
- {産業|さんぎょう}{廃棄物|はいきぶつ}{焼却場|しょうきゃくじょう}: industrial waste incineration plant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {焼却炉|しょうきゃくろ}: incinerator — the furnace unit itself, not the whole facility
- {清掃|せいそう}{工場|こうじょう}: waste processing plant — euphemism used by many municipalities
- {処理場|しょりじょう}: processing plant — broader term for any waste treatment facility
- {埋|う}め{立|た}て{地|ち}: landfill — alternative disposal method where waste is buried
